tools.name: backplan_check
tools.description: Validate a backward-derived work plan (end state, success criteria, per-issue objective/scope/completion criteria, Linear project mapping, policy decisions, automation candidates) against the fixed contract and render Linear-ready project/issue payloads plus a stable content digest. Deterministic, offline and keyless: it never writes to Linear or touches the network; registration stays with the agent's Linear MCP or linear-trace.py path. Fire at the moment executable work arrives (unclear completion criteria, multi-step or multi-repo scope, undecided project attribution, scope needing agreement) — never as a recurring ritual, and never for pure read-only questions.
